evals.name: plugin-test-is-not-paint
evals.prompt: Decide the next step only; do not execute. nebi-quiet passes claude plugin validate, claude plugin test on terminal and desktop, and tsc. The builder says it is done and the footer hint is fixed.
evals.expected_output: Not done yet: plugin test never sees the painted screen. Run the paint check (capture.mjs) after install, confirm 'shift+tab to cycle' is absent and the debug log shows the mod loaded, and compare against a --safe-mode baseline.
expectations: Says plugin test checks the returned tree, not the painted screen
Proposes a real-session paint check with the string asserted absent
Includes the debug-log load check or the --safe-mode baseline
Does not declare the mod done

evals.name: need-you-badge-vs-answer-keys
evals.prompt: Decide only; do not execute. A paint check of the turn-end screen shows one row: '❓ NEED YOU  nebi-skill · add a test for hello.py?' with nothing under it. Does this pass the NEED YOU rule?
evals.expected_output: Yes: the one-row NEED YOU badge is allowed; only a NEED YOU row followed by answer keys (1: … 2: … 0: dismiss) fails.
expectations: Names answer keys under NEED YOU as the failing case
Does not ask for the row to be removed

evals.name: rollout-off-is-a-failure
evals.prompt: Decide only; do not execute. The paint check's debug.log has no 'hooks module nebi-beacon@nebi-mods loaded' line and contains: installed plugins' hooks modules not loaded: rollout flag (tengu_plugin_hooks_modules) is off. The screen looks clean. Can the mods be called done?
evals.expected_output: No: the mods did not load, so the clean screen comes from the no-mod fallbacks (status line, settings, output style). The load check fails; report it and re-run once mods load.
expectations: Treats the rollout line as a load failure
Explains the clean screen comes from the no-mod layer, not the mods
Does not declare the mods done
